integrityFindings.issue: Yahoo enrichment stored the last 5-minute bar volume as generic volume, creating a semantic mismatch against cumulative Finviz volume and potential contamination of RVOL/volume-derived learning.
integrityFindings.action: Changed Yahoo volume to the sum of available 5-minute chart bars, retained intervalVolume separately, and tagged volumeSemantic plus a coverage warning.

integrityFindings.issue: Final Snapshot Reconciliation did not explicitly require source timestamps to align to the same final window/session before declaring price/change reconciliation.
integrityFindings.action: Added <=10-minute timestamp alignment and same-session-date gates. Timestamp mismatch now produces SOURCE_TIMESTAMP_MISMATCH and blocks training.

integrityFindings.issue: Volume reconciliation did not require compatible volume semantics between independent sources.
integrityFindings.action: Volume-derived training now requires volumeSemantic=chart_bar_sum_session_cumulative plus timestamp alignment and <=10% volume difference.

promotionReason: No reconciled multi-session evidence of material predictive improvement; this cycle corrected data semantics and reconciliation gates only.
